$comment: Sample tour for the tutorial engine (docs/plans/tutorial.md): three steps, used by the engine tests and the sample GUI run. Help > Tutorials lists it; the first-launch welcome card offers the bracket tour.
title: Quick tour: your first sketch
description: Three short steps: move the 3D view, start a sketch and pick the **XY** plane. About a minute. You can leave the tour at any time from Help > Tutorials.
finish: That's it: you are sketching on the **XY** plane. Draw something, then click **Finish Sketch** or press [[Ctrl+Enter]].

steps.text: Orbit with a **right-drag**, pan with a **middle-drag**, zoom with the **wheel**. A right click without dragging opens the menu. Press [[Home]] to reset the view, then click **Next**.

steps.hint: It is the first button of the **SKETCH** section in the toolbar.

steps.text: Click the **XY** plane, the flat one. The view turns to look straight at it.
steps.hint: Click inside the flat square, not on its edge.
